objectClass.notes: Single three-quarter front reference. Front and visible left side are high confidence; back and hidden right side use conservative symmetry and architectural continuation. The result is a stylized real-time reconstruction, not survey-grade architecture.

reasoning: The silhouette combines a broad main gable prism, offset front gable, chimney, deep eaves, hanging sign, quest board, and barrel cluster.
The facade contains repeated ashlar blocks, timber posts and braces, roof tile courses, sign hardware, paper notices, and barrel staves.
Distinct stone, timber, plaster, tile, painted sign, gold emblem, iron, paper, and rope responses require separate material treatment.
A single image leaves the rear elevation uncertain, but the visible construction system supports a conservative volumetric reconstruction.

specDepthDecision.rationale: The guild identity depends on a true solid roof volume plus layered architecture and facade prop systems; a shallow shell or single mesh cannot preserve the reference.

detailInventory.note: Fourteen image-observed detail systems are linked to planned component localFeatures or material localOverrides.

details.description: Overlapping horizontal terracotta tile courses step down both roof slopes.
Muted green moss accumulates along tile overlaps and ridge edges.
Staggered brick courses and recessed mortar lines break up the chimney.
Raised vertical posts, rails, and diagonal braces form the upper half-timber lattice.
Round wooden pegs and carved square joint blocks punctuate the floor beam and capitals.
Irregular ashlar blocks have recessed dark mortar seams and offset courses.
Heavy arcade posts terminate in stepped carved capitals and stone plinths.
A raised gold inset border sits on the dark green sign face.
Two gold swords cross diagonally as a thick raised emblem with guards and pommels.
Two short black chain runs suspend the sign from the projecting timber arm.
Overlapping parchment notices of varied sizes and warm tones are pinned to the freestanding board.
Dark strap hinges and a compact handle sit proud of the open plank door.
Sparse hairline cracks and uneven discoloration interrupt the warm plaster infill.
Dark iron hoops wrap vertically oriented staved barrels at the right facade.

definitionOfDone: The model reads immediately as the reference guildhall from a three-quarter facade view and remains volumetric from side and rear-quarter views.
The main roof and front gable are closed triangular-prism or extruded solids with real gable end faces; two rotated box slabs are a blocking failure.
Stone base, timber arcade, half-timber upper storey, terracotta roof, green sword sign, quest board, and barrels are separate named systems with visible depth.
The sole rests at y=0, the facade faces +Z, and createAdventurersGuildModel returns an action-ready THREE.Group.

featureGroups.name: Solid gable roof and guildhall massing
qualityCriteria: Closed roof geometry carries both slopes, gable end faces, eaves, ridge, and chimney interruption.
The upper storey overhangs the stone base and secondary front gable interrupts the roofline.

featureGroups.name: Stone base, arcade, and half-timber hierarchy
qualityCriteria: Ground-storey stone courses, heavy timber posts, stepped capitals, floor beam, and upper braces remain separate depth layers.

featureGroups.name: Green hanging sign with crossed swords
qualityCriteria: Projecting timber arm, two chain runs, framed green panel, and two raised gold swords are readable at hero-preview distance.
failureModes: generic crossed sticks without guards or points

featureGroups.name: Quest board, open door, and barrel cluster
qualityCriteria: Quest board has legs, frame, varied overlapping papers and pins; right facade has at least three staved barrels with dark hoops.

featureGroups.name: Aged material and relief separation
qualityCriteria: Stone, timber, plaster, tile, paint, metal, and paper use distinct albedo and roughness ranges.
Tile overlaps, mortar seams, joinery pegs, moss, cracks, and edge wear remain visible under grazing light.

antiShallowSpecRules: Reject any roof made from two rotated boxes or planes.
Reject any solution that collapses the facade into a billboard.
Reject code generation until all fourteen inventory details map to actual component features or material overrides.
Reject a structural pass without real depth between wall, arcade, sign, quest board, and props.
Reject a material pass that reuses albedo as roughness, normal, height, or ambient occlusion.
Reject a factory whose sole is not y=0 or whose facade is not +Z.
